    Profile

    Chihaya is a shrine maiden from Wadatsumi. Considering the war scars of Wadatsumi, she's endorsed by her community because of the mental support she means to the people. She's very collected for her age, and thanks to her adultlike charm, she's very popular amongst guys.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Female
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Oct 10
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Hair decorations and combs
    Hobbies: Playing with kids
    Illust: こめこ
    CV: 斎藤千和
